title: Rate Book Minimum Bill Provision for Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Monthly minimum — in force.** When the facility, energy and demand lines of one billing period of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account together come to less than the monthly minimum, a minimum bill adjustment line for the difference is added. The monthly minimum is the higher of the schedule's minimum monthly charge and the schedule's monthly minimum per kVA multiplied by the account's installed transformer kVA. Idle periods in which no facility charge bills carry no monthly minimum.

**Annual minimum on the December bill — no longer in force.** The former provision under which the December bill compared the calendar year's facility, energy and demand lines with the annual minimum per kVA multiplied by the transformer kVA, and added an annual minimum adjustment line for any shortfall, prorating the annual minimum for an account energized during the year by whole calendar months energized divided by twelve, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current seasonal minimum settlement basis for irrigation service accounts; the annual minimum per kVA figure itself remains as stated on the rate book.

**What counts toward a minimum — in force.** Power cost adjustment, sales tax and fees never count toward either minimum. Minimum lines carry no kWh.

### Hypothetical worked case — a Schedule GS-3 shop

Inputs (hypothetical): transformer 45 kVA; the period's facility, energy and demand lines total $60.00; the period also carries a $4.10 power cost adjustment line.

1. The per-kVA monthly minimum is $1.25 multiplied by 45 kVA, which is $56.25; the minimum monthly charge is $68.50. The higher of the two, $68.50, is the monthly minimum.
2. Only the $60.00 of facility, energy and demand lines counts; the power cost adjustment does not.
3. The shortfall is $68.50 less $60.00, so a minimum bill adjustment line of $8.50 is added.

### Branches of the monthly minimum

| Facility, energy and demand lines of the period | Result |
|---|---|
| Below the monthly minimum | A minimum bill adjustment line for the difference |
| At or above the monthly minimum | No minimum line |
| Idle period with no facility charge billing | No monthly minimum applies |

superseded_clauses: Where annual_minimum_per_kva is above zero, the December bill compares service_msr_calendar_year_base_charges for that calendar year with annual_minimum_per_kva multiplied by transformer_kva and adds an annual_minimum_adjustment line for any shortfall; an account energized during the year has the annual minimum prorated by the number of whole calendar months it was energized divided by twelve, rounded to the cent.
